Reranking with only a single document

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.rerank_async(LiterLlm::RerankRequest.new(documents: ['Artificial intelligence is the simulation of human intelligence.'], model: 'rerank-v3.5', query: 'What is AI?'))
puts result.results.inspect
puts result.results[0].relevance_score.inspect
```
